request.style: English, gentle male child voice, solo with warm choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, light percussion, cello, hopeful but somber mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Amon was twenty-two when he began to rule
He reigned two years in the city of Jerusalem
His mother was Meshullemeth from the town of Jotbah
He did what was evil in the eyes of the Lord

[Chorus]
Two years in Jerusalem, a short and dark time
He walked in the ways of his father’s sin
Bowing down to idols, leaving the Lord behind
Two years in Jerusalem, a heavy, heavy crown

[Verse]
He served the idols that Manasseh made
He forsook the God who had led his fathers
He did not humble himself before the Lord
Instead he multiplied his guilt and shame

[Chorus]
Two years in Jerusalem, a short and dark time
He walked in the ways of his father’s sin
Bowing down to idols, leaving the Lord behind
Two years in Jerusalem, a heavy, heavy crown

[Bridge]
His officials conspired against him in his house
They killed the king and ended his brief reign
The people struck down all who plotted against him
And they made his son Josiah king

[Outro]
Buried in the garden of Uzza’s tomb
His son Josiah succeeded him on the throne
The annals record the acts of Amon
A link in the line of the kings of Judah
